name: park_joy
note: Hand-held pan across a park, water spray and foliage. The hardest kind of content to code: motion in every direction and no flat area to hide in.

name: in_to_tree
note: A slow push toward a tree line. Almost no global motion, but dense high-frequency leaf detail everywhere.

name: blue_sky
note: A rotating shot of bare branches against an open sky. Large smooth gradients next to hard thin edges: the classic banding trap.
